failures.cause: The first real runner probe exposed Docker's added LC_CTYPE value to the user command, exceeding the frozen four-name environment allowlist.
failures.corrected_by: The no-shell Python bootstrap now clears the effective process environment in-process before executing the admitted v1 script, module, or code profile.

failures.cause: An invalid UUID initially escaped the workflow archive lookup as an unhandled JournalError instead of preserving the stable rejected-command envelope.
failures.corrected_by: The CLI now treats an invalid archive identifier as an archive miss and delegates to the existing journal command, which retains the stable usage and evidence semantics.
